messages:
priya: Heads up — noticed a small but consistent bias in answers from the lowbit (4-bit) path for a finance customer after yesterday's canary. Examples skew toward overly confident dates for historical events. Putting this on the ops/ML radar. :eyes:

jamie: ugh. do we have a diff of shadow vs prod for the same prompts? could be calibration shift in FP8->4bit conversion or a KV cache mismatch.

sasha: @priya can you paste the prompt+response pair? also which model variant + quant profile (fp8-int8-4bit cascade?)

priya: quick snippet (redacted):
```
Q: "When was the founding of Acme Corp?"
Shadow lowbit: "March 12, 1989"
Baseline fp16: "March 12, 1990"
```
The pattern repeats across ~30 prompts in the eval set, not just single token diffs.

mike: my hunch: rounding + sign-preserve scaling could bias certain head outputs. Also check per-head saturations.

jamie: agree. run headwise activation histograms and compare mean shifts between fp16 shadow and 4-bit. if we see mean drift -> calibration table bug.

priya: running the replay job now on a 2k prompt sample with shadow traffic. cmd I ran: 
```
replay --trace=shadow --filter=model:rwkv-13b,profile:4bit-cascade --since=2024-12-01 --out=/tmp/replay-lowbit.ndjson
```
ETA ~8m.

opsbot: replay job started (id=rj-20241208-03). estimated completion 8m.

jamie: also capture token-level confidence + topk deltas. add these fields to the replay: `meta.top_probs, meta.kv_checksum, meta.quant_scale_table`

priya: good call. adding now.

sasha: Can we triage the rollout? If this is noisy but customer-facing, probably hold canary and rollback dedicated customers until we have a root cause.

mike: if it's a calibration table issue we can hotfix with a remap patch instead of full model rollback. need to check compatibility with the runtime quant shim.

priya: putting a hold on further lowbit canaries for the next 24h. @deploy-bot can you block the profile `4bit-cascade` from new rollouts?

deploy-bot: blocked profile `4bit-cascade` from new canaries and scheduled deployments.

jamie: operational checklist proposal:
- run headwise histograms + mean/var diffs
- run per-token topk/entropy comparison
- check quant_scale_table drift and sign-preserve flags
- reproduce locally with a smaller seed and bisect heads
- if confirmed, publish an interim remap patch and shadow it
- notify affected customers + CS to expect possible micro-regressions

priya: I'll own the first three. jamie, can you take the bisect (head-level) tomorrow morning? sasha please coordinate CS comms.

sasha: will draft an internal summary + a short customer note (non-technical) after we confirm.

mike: if bisect points to a tiny head subset we could implement a directional clamp for those heads in runtime (per-head scale overrides) as a fast mitigation. longer term: add an acceptance test for per-head mean drift during quant profile creation.

priya: noted. adding ticket to backlog: `ML-ops: per-head-drift-acceptance-test` and `OPS: quant-profile-hotpatch-remap`.

priya: interim telemetry findings (first pass): mean activation shift concentrated in heads 5, 11, 19; topk entropy reduced slightly in lowbit vs fp16. saving full dump to /mnt/telemetry/rj-20241208-03/*.

jamie: nice — that narrows it. start a focused bisect on heads [5,11,19]. if patchable, test remap on shadow and measure deviation on the same eval set.

priya: will run bisect and post results. thx everyone. :thumbsup:

opsbot: replay job completed (id=rj-20241208-03). artifacts: /mnt/telemetry/rj-20241208-03/ (logs + ndjson).
